rules: A new authoritative state must pass complete item and corpse validation before persistence.
An existing primary generation must independently validate before it may be rotated into backup.
Primary recovery may occur only when the primary is absent, corrupt, or fails complete runtime validation.
A backup must independently deserialize and pass complete runtime validation before recovery.
Successful recovery atomically restores the backup bytes to the authoritative primary path before state is returned.
Failure of both generations surfaces an explicit error and does not silently create empty state.

ownership.items: item and corpse state validation, generation rotation, and recovery
ownership.world_runtime: save scheduling and coordinated checkpoint timing

native_boundary: Native MajorMUD journaling, backup count, and cross-save recovery order remain pending final WCC/WBB/native exhaustion.
